use_cases: Displaying multi-step processes or workflows in a horizontally scrollable timeline format
Visualizing project milestones or onboarding steps with animated transitions
Creating interactive process documentation that responds to user scroll behavior
Building step-by-step tutorials with visual card-based content display
Designing timeline-based landing page sections for software products
ai_summary: A scroll-animated horizontal process timeline component featuring glassmorphism styling with backdrop blur effects and gradient backgrounds. Uses framer-motion for smooth scroll-linked animations and transform effects. Supports multiple size variants (sm/md/lg/xl) and dual theme options (indigo dark/light). Includes Context API for scroll progress tracking and is designed to showcase sequential process steps or milestones with modern visual aesthetics.
